name: Market risk
consideration: Prices can move quickly and losses may exceed expectations.
example: A currency pair gaps over a weekend and opens far from Friday's close.
what_to_check: Risk disclosure / risk warning; Product or contract specifications

name: Leverage risk
consideration: Leverage amplifies both gains and losses.
example: At 1:100 leverage, a 1% adverse move equals 100% of the margin used.
what_to_check: Leverage and margin terms; Risk disclosure / risk warning

name: Digital asset risk
consideration: Cryptocurrency prices and liquidity can change sharply, 24 hours a day.
example: A token falls 20% overnight while traditional markets are closed.
what_to_check: Product or contract specifications; Crypto deposit and withdrawal instructions

name: Stablecoin risk
consideration: Peg stability and redemption depend on the issuer and market conditions.
example: USDT briefly traded below US$1 during market stress in May 2022.

name: Blockchain risk
consideration: Transfers are generally irreversible and can be lost on an incompatible network.
example: USDT sent on Ethereum to an address expecting Tron cannot be credited normally.

name: Operational risk
consideration: Outages, maintenance and processing delays can affect trading and payments.
example: A withdrawal is delayed during a platform or network outage.
what_to_check: Terms and conditions / client agreement; Deposit and withdrawal terms

name: Counterparty risk
consideration: You depend on the operator's ability to honour trades and return funds.
example: The operator acts as the counterparty to client trades.
what_to_check: Conflicts of interest policy; Operator identity

name: Regulatory risk
consideration: Legal requirements and protections differ by jurisdiction and product.
example: A product available in one country may be restricted in another.
what_to_check: Licence and regulator disclosure; Terms and conditions / client agreement
